import axios_api from"./axios";import{apiPath}from"./config";const host=apiPath("/order/sellercustomer");// 전체 조회
export const getCustomer=async()=>{console.log("[API][GET]",host);const res=await axios_api.get(host);return res.data;};// 등록
export const createCustomer=async formData=>{const res=await axios_api.post(host,formData);return res.data;};// 수정
export const updateCustomer=async(cusNo,formData)=>{const res=await axios_api.put(apiPath("/order/sellercustomer/".concat(cusNo)));return res.data;};// 삭제
export const deleteCustomer=async cusNo=>{const res=await axios_api.delete(apiPath("/order/sellercustomer/".concat(cusNo)));return res.data;};
